auth.welcomeSubtitle: Track accounts, spending, and savings goals in one place.

onboarding.step1Subtitle: Set your name, base currency, appearance, and privacy mode.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Keep the templates you need or add your own. Supports inline math like =50000+12500.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Select your core expense & income categories or add custom ones.
onboarding.privacyDefaultHint: Blurs all monetary figures until you toggle the eye icon.
onboarding.successToast: Welcome to Strata! Your workspace is ready.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your appearance, language, currency, security, and active sessions.

emailChange.dialogDescriptionPassword: Enter your new email address and confirm with your current password.
emailChange.dialogDescriptionMfa: Enter your new email address and verify with a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
emailChange.totpHint: Once you enter the 6th digit, we will send the confirmation link.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
totp.subtitle: Protect sign-ins with one-time 6-digit TOTP authenticator codes.

totp.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
totp.manualSecretLabel: Or enter this setup key manually
totp.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app.
totp.disableDescription: Enter a current 6-digit code from your authenticator app to turn off 2FA.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.
sessions.revokeConfirmBody: Access on "{device}" will be terminated immediately.
sessions.revokeOtherBody: Every session except this device will be revoked immediately.

dangerZone.title: Delete account
dangerZone.subtitle: Permanently delete your profile and all financial records.
dangerZone.warningText: This permanently deletes your profile, accounts, operations, categories, goals, debts, and active sessions. This action cannot be undone.
dangerZone.dialogDescription: Confirm with your current password. All Strata data will be erased immediately and cannot be recovered.
dangerZone.totpHint: 2FA is active on this account — enter a 6-digit code to confirm.
dangerZone.confirmCheck: I understand this deletion is permanent and all data will be lost.

dashboard.safeToSpendNote: Based on liquid accounts & credit obligations
dashboard.noAccounts: No accounts yet — add your first account in Capital.
dashboard.noOperations: No operations yet — tap Add or press N to record your first one.

analytics.trendCashflowSubtitle: Income, net expenses, and net balance for {year}
analytics.noChartData: No confirmed operations for this year yet.
analytics.noCategorySpend: No net category spending in this period.

layout.hint: Drag blocks on desktop or reorder with arrows — saved to your profile.

transactions.title: Operations
transactions.subtitle: Full history across all accounts and 11 operation types.

transactions.noAccountsHint: You have no active accounts yet. Create one in Capital or save as a draft.
transactions.commentDebtPlaceholder: Include counterparty name for FIFO debt matching...
transactions.draftToggleHint: Drafts do not affect account balances until confirmed.
transactions.deleteConfirmBody: The operation will be removed from your ledger and balances will recalculate.

typeDescriptions.transfer: Move money between your own accounts without affecting income or spending.
typeDescriptions.compensation: Split bill or refund that offsets category spending without inflating income.
typeDescriptions.transit_in: Third-party funds passing through your account (excluded from income).
typeDescriptions.transit_out: Passing third-party funds onward (excluded from expenses).
typeDescriptions.debt_received_back: Someone paid back a debt to you.
typeDescriptions.debt_paid_back: You paid back money you owed.

filters.emptyBody: Adjust your filters or add a new operation.

capital.title: Capital
capital.subtitle: Manage your accounts, credit limits, and budget categories.
capital.activeSwitchHint: Archived accounts stay in history but are hidden from Quick Add.
capital.deleteAccountBody: The account will be archived from active views while preserving historical operations.
capital.passiveSwitchHint: Tracked separately as cashback, interest, or dividends.
capital.noCategories: No categories in this section yet.
capital.deleteCategoryBody: Existing operations will remain in your history without this category.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Savings yields, Promo Radar, recurring bills, goal envelopes, and debts.

savings.deleteRuleBody: Your account and balance remain untouched, but interest forecasts and Promo Radar tracking will stop.
savings.untrackedTitle: Savings accounts without a rate rule
savings.untrackedSubtitle: Add an interest rule for your savings or deposit accounts to track yield and promo expirations.
savings.emptyBody: Configure base and promo APY on your savings or deposit accounts to forecast interest and watch promo end dates.
savings.noEligibleAccounts: Create a savings, deposit, or debit account in Capital first.
savings.duplicateRuleError: A savings rule already exists for this account.

form.capitalizationHint: Interest is added to the account balance for compounding.
form.minBalanceOverridePlaceholder: Leave blank to use current balance
form.promoDateRequired: Specify a promo end date when promo rate is above 0%.
form.invalidRate: Enter an interest rate between 0 and 100%.

recurring.safeToSpendNote: Reserved automatically from Safe to Spend
recurring.deletePaymentBody: Past operations stay in your ledger, while future reminders and Safe-to-Spend reserves stop.
recurring.emptyBody: Add rent, internet, or subscriptions so unpaid bills reserve automatically in Safe to Spend.
recurring.markedToast: Marked as paid for this month.

form.keywordHint: Expenses this month whose note contains this keyword mark the bill as paid automatically.
form.isActiveHint: Reserves in Safe to Spend until paid in the current month.

goals.nperNoPlan: Set a monthly plan to forecast completion
goals.deleteGoalBody: The goal envelope will be deleted while real account balances and operations remain intact.
goals.recentTransfersSubtitle: Virtual reallocation without moving money across bank accounts.
goals.deleteTransferBody: Both goal envelopes will be recalculated automatically.
goals.emptyBody: Create virtual envelopes on your savings accounts and forecast NPER completion timelines.

form.storageAccountHint: When linked to a savings rule, NPER uses its effective annual interest rate.
form.invalidTarget: Target amount must be greater than zero.

transfer.title: Transfer between goals
transfer.subtitle: Move funds virtually from one goal envelope to another without changing bank account balances.
transfer.exceedsBalanceWarning: Amount exceeds the source envelope's current balance.
transfer.noSourceGoals: You need at least two active goals to transfer funds.

debts.deleteDebtBody: Historical operations stay in your ledger, while this debt leaves the tracker and Net Worth calculation.
debts.emptyBody: Track both money owed to you and money you owe — repayments settle automatically via FIFO.

form.createTxToggleHint: Creates a linked lent or borrowed operation and updates the selected account balance.
form.manualExceedsAmount: Manual repaid amount cannot exceed total debt amount.

tour.settingsSubtitle: Replay the quick walkthrough covering shortcuts, analytics, and privacy controls.

hero-balance.title: Net Worth & balances
hero-balance.description: See your net worth, safe-to-spend balance (after unpaid recurring bills), period net, credit limits, and Promo Radar alerts.

privacy-toggle.title: Privacy Blur mode
privacy-toggle.description: Tap the eye icon anytime to blur all monetary values and chart axes in public spaces.

quick-add.title: Quick Add & inline math
quick-add.description: Record any of the 11 operation types in the receipt-style card, calculate inline (320+185), or press N from anywhere.

analytics-charts.title: Period analytics & budgets
analytics-charts.description: Switch between Month and Year views, track income, expenses, and net balance trends, inspect category shares, or reorder blocks via Order.

nav-sections.title: Workspace navigation
nav-sections.description: Review history in Operations, accounts and budgets in Capital, savings APY, Promo Radar, bills, NPER goals & FIFO debts in Plans, and customize in Settings.

settings-link.title: Themes, 2FA & backups
settings-link.description: Choose a theme and 5 accent palettes, manage 2FA and active sessions, export JSON/CSV backups, or replay this tour anytime.

export.title: Data export
export.subtitle: Download a complete JSON backup or a filtered CSV spreadsheet of your operations.
export.jsonDescription: Portable snapshot of your profile, accounts, categories, operations, goals, and debts.
export.csvDescription: UTF-8 spreadsheet ready for Excel across your selected date range.

admin.title: Admin Console
admin.subtitle: Aggregate platform telemetry, invite code management, and cloud feature flags.
admin.privacyNoticeBody: Only anonymous aggregate counts are visible here. Individual user accounts, transactions, debts, and balances remain strictly inaccessible via Postgres RLS.

telemetry.title: Platform telemetry
telemetry.subtitle: Aggregate-only counts with zero PII or financial rows.

invites.title: Invite codes
invites.subtitle: Issue, pause, or revoke registration invites.

flags.title: Cloud Feature Flags
flags.subtitle: Control rollouts across Web PWA and Android without redeploying.
